name: agent_skills
description: A collection of Claude Code skills for Obsidian power users, including CLI integration and plugin development
author: Ken Graham

skills.name: obsidian-cli
skills.description: Interact with Obsidian vaults using the Obsidian CLI tool. Read, create, search, and manage notes, tasks, tags, properties, plugins, and more.

skills.name: obsidian-plugin
skills.description: Build and edit Obsidian plugins using TypeScript and the Obsidian API. Supports plugin development, feature implementation, and publishing workflows.

requirements.obsidian: For obsidian-cli skill: Obsidian desktop app must be running and obsidian CLI must be installed
requirements.node: For obsidian-plugin skill: Node.js and npm/yarn for plugin development
